svg.title: Machinist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as machinist, wearing coveralls. Visible work cue: A lathe headstock and projecting chuck hold a clearly stepped turned workpiece over the machine bed. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
